name: foraging-fox-enter-look5-reveal-fatestone
notes: Foraging Fox (b0ssellm84, GeneratedMacroCode.php enterAbilities["b0ssellm84:0"] moves the top 5 deck cards to myTempZone and offers an MZMAYCHOOSE of any FATESTONE candidates found; customDQHandlers["b0ssellm84:0:Enter-1"] moves the chosen card to memory then calls ForagingFoxChooseBottom to return the rest): "On Enter: Look at the top five cards of your deck. You may reveal a Fatestone card from among them and put it into your memory. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order." Foraging Fox is patched into a known hand slot and a Craggy Fatestone is patched into deck position 2 (within the top five) so the fixture doesn't depend on shuffle luck for either. Fox is materialized for real via FSM play (not a raw zone-seed) so its genuine Enter() fires. Verified live: after choosing to reveal the Craggy Fatestone (myTempZone-2) and rearranging the remaining 4 filler cards to the bottom, the Craggy Fatestone is in memory and the deck count returns to 12 (net -1 for the revealed card that left the deck). Break/restore verified: commenting out the MZMove(...,"myMemory") call makes the fixture fail (Fatestone never leaves the deck) and restoring it passes again.
